summary: MDA Space Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a $474 million contract increase from Telesat to expand the Lightspeed LEO constellation by 27 additional MDA AURORA satellites, bringing total funded satellites to 225 and MDA's order to 198. The increase includes adding 500 MHz of military Ka-band spectrum. MDA was also named prime contractor for the ESCP-P program's UHF/X-band MEO constellation, with negotiations ongoing. This is an ordinary operational contract award, not a special-situation corporate event.
